title.zh-CN: 故障接管、隔离与资源调度

gap.zh-CN: 双 Agent 同库切换、报告及回执接收、双 SQL 围栏和候选显式启动已实测，已审批排空的交接也能在 Controller 退出后续办。原 Agent 强制终止时，两入口区分节点租约过期与任务状态未知。原目录重启先执行离线 STOP，再经显式 START 续传，旧 Agent 和采集代次均已隔离。已实测原 Agent 仅失去同库控制和日志路径时停止旧 Worker，原进程重连后先办离线 STOP，显式启动后双目标各应用一次。在途 PostgreSQL 真行锁档案实测未提交部分回滚，续传后两目标原生日志各写入一次。PostgreSQL 目标已提交但日志未确认时，断网期间由日志库回收旧 ACK 锁。原 Agent 重连处理离线 STOP，显式 START 仅推进原 ACK，双目标无重复写入。MySQL 目标的对称档案也通过，确认恢复时仅推进选定目标的 ACK。原 Agent 失联时，管理界面可只读检查历史排空、回执和当前修订，缺少持久禁写或完整归档会明确阻止离线接管。永久丢失的实际接管及完整排空矩阵待验。
gap.en: Native tests cover same-store dual-Agent transfer, evidence, dual SQL fencing, approved Worker continuation and an approved drained handoff after Controller loss. When the original Agent is killed, both entries distinguish the expired node lease from unknown task state. Same-directory restart first executes the queued STOP. Explicit START consumes the retained backlog while former Agent and capture epochs remain fenced. A native control and journal path partition stopped the former Worker. The original process completed queued STOP after reconnecting. Explicit START consumed the backlog once on each target. With a PostgreSQL target row lock in flight, the partial target transaction rolled back and each native target log recorded one insert and one update. The journal releases the stale ACK row lock during partition after the PostgreSQL target commits. The original Agent completes queued STOP after reconnect. Explicit START reconciles the original ACK, with one application per target. The symmetric MySQL case also passed, and only the selected target ACK advances in either case. Both management entries show the offline task's historical cut, receipt custody and current revision. The read-only profile requires a durable freeze and complete archive before takeover. Permanent loss and broader drain remain.

acceptance.zh-CN: 节点断电/网络分区/旧节点恢复时同一任务无双写；未确认停机可标记未知并隔离；按JDK、连接器、存储可达性和配额调度；排空迁移保留断点。
acceptance.en: Power loss,partition and stale-node return never permit dual writers;unconfirmed stops remain unknown/fenced;placement respects JDK,adapter,storage reachability and quotas;drain/move preserves progress.

PostgreSQL 17.12 extended NUMERIC scales passed PostgreSQL and MySQL native delivery, including source rounding, 65 digits, keyless multiplicity and whole-transaction refusal of NaN. Finite PostgreSQL 17.12 REAL and DOUBLE PRECISION passed with PostgreSQL and MySQL targets. Adjacent values, subnormals, keyless duplicates and restart preserve values. gap.en: Oracle 26ai single-PDB archive CDC to PostgreSQL covers long transactions, SCN restart, strict text JSON, civil DATE and opt-in bounded virtual integer multiplication, addition and subtraction. Keyless duplicates, SQL NULL and original-snapshot archive replay passed. Other expressions, native binary JSON, LOB and RAC failover remain. Native Oracle Free evidence shows incomplete LOB before-images for BasicFiles and SecureFiles changes. Restricted-role preflight exposes the matching refusal. Full LOB capture remains open. Native archived CDC covers nested savepoints and partial rollback. Both PostgreSQL subscriptions reuse their original snapshots and SCN after process kills, and committed rows match Oracle Flashback at the same SCN. Native binary JSON in Oracle Free 26ai lacks before/after images in the measured LogMiner archive. Restricted JDBC Flashback can read it. Preflight refuses it until a reliable CDC profile is available. Native AL32UTF8 and AL16UTF16 diagnostics match 40 character changes and 60 images. CHAR, NCHAR and NVARCHAR2 up to 4000 dictionary bytes passed restart on two PostgreSQL subscriptions with original SCNs and exact padding.

acceptance.zh-CN: 确定并记录LogMiner/XStream等路线、版本/权限/驱动分发条件；实现SCN一致性快照、提交/回滚、redo/归档、DBID/incarnation识别、断点与重复恢复，逐项验证LOB、字符集、PDB/RAC等范围。

acceptance.en: Record sync/recovery/manual capabilities by product,version,mode,distribution/index/driver/JDK;commercial distributed hardware is separately accepted,not inferred from PG protocol connectivity.

title.zh-CN: 非空接管、约束恢复、切换回切

gap.zh-CN: 限定档案已验收。冻结 MySQL 的同一非空 PostgreSQL 单表完成差异审阅、原切点接管、恢复已审批的 BIGINT UNIQUE、业务切换及首次提交写入前回切，并复用原快照继续 CDC。另一个同切点档案验证了二进制排序、NO PAD 的 VARCHAR UNIQUE(email)，保留原普通索引并继续 CDC。更广产品及写后逆向迁移分别跟踪。
gap.en: Bounded single-table PostgreSQL profile accepted. At one frozen MySQL cut the fixture reviewed differences, adopted, restored an approved BIGINT UNIQUE, transferred business writes, performed pre-write failback and reused the original snapshot. A second profile at the same cut verifies binary, NO PAD VARCHAR UNIQUE(email), retains the ordinary index and continues CDC. Broader products and post-write reverse migration are separate.

acceptance.zh-CN: 实现非空目标差异计划/校验、UNIQUE等约束重建、最终源屏障、业务写入交接及回切条件；双写/双向复制单独定义，不隐含承诺无冲突。
acceptance.en: Implement adoption/difference planning,constraint restoration,final source cut,write handoff and failback conditions;dual-write/bidirectional conflict policy is separately specified.

verification.profile: Temurin 21, standalone MySQL 8.4.13 and one keyed existing PostgreSQL 17.12 table with one signed BIGINT business UNIQUE. Reviewed difference, downgraded ordinary index, same frozen cut adoption and attested restoration, role switch and pre-write failback, and original snapshot CDC continuation. Multi-target and post-write reverse replication are separate.

title.zh-CN: ClickHouse/Doris/Hive生产档案

gap.zh-CN: ClickHouse、Doris 和内置目录 Hive 已有原生恢复档案。Hive 4.0.1 外置 PostgreSQL Metastore 通过全量、增量、原目录身份、整组重启、Worker 原快照续传、四批回执与独立 SQL 错误重放。分布式仓库、生产集群、旧备份恢复和容量仍在验收。
gap.en: ClickHouse, Doris and embedded Hive have native recovery evidence. Hive 4.0.1 with an external PostgreSQL Metastore passed snapshot, CDC, original catalog identity, service restart, original-snapshot Worker recovery, four batch receipts and isolated SQL error replay. Distributed storage, production clusters, old backup recovery and capacity remain.

acceptance.zh-CN: 各产品按真实可见水位、去重/批次回执验证重启、旧备份、集群故障和缺口；不能承诺普通SQL跨表事务语义。
acceptance.en: Verify visibility,dedup/batch receipts,restart,old-backup,cluster and gaps per product without claiming ordinary SQL cross-table atomicity.

title.zh-CN: 全部消息目标的集群与恢复协议

gap.zh-CN: NATS TLS、RabbitMQ 多数派、Kafka KRaft 和 Redis Streams 外部提升及消费恢复已有原生档案。Pulsar 4.0.14 已验证单 Broker 私有 CA/Token，以及双 Broker、三 BookKeeper 下的原 Topic 恢复、确认不足时暂停确认和同事件重试。双 Broker 私有 CA/Token 与三节点 ZooKeeper 主节点故障后的元数据写入也已通过。跨主机存储故障域、内部链路加密、负载容量和其他消息目标档案待验。 Artemis 2.57.0 主进程强杀后由共享卷备进程接管。相同入口复用原生回执及队列身份并确认同一重试。 ActiveMQ Classic 5.19.12 已实测同一 KahaDB 卷的主备切换。固定 OpenWire 和 Jolokia 入口切换后，发行包发布器核验原归属和回执，确认同一重试事件。旧主重启保持备用。 RocketMQ 5.5.0 Broker 原生验收已验证三副本提升、旧物理位点和内容保留。首次演练发现 Topic 配置可能落后于 CommitLog，复验分别核对两个条件。可选 Rivomesh 发布器档案已通过三副本主备切换、原回执续传和两副本下限保护。完整 Worker、Controller 集群及安全档案待验。
gap.en: Native NATS TLS, RabbitMQ quorum, Kafka KRaft and Redis Streams external promotion and consumer recovery passed. Pulsar 4.0.14 covers single-broker TLS and Token and a two-broker, three-bookie profile with original topic recovery, withheld confirmations below quorum and stable-event retry. Two-broker private TLS and Token, and new metadata after loss of a leader in the three-node ZooKeeper quorum, also passed. Cross-host storage failure domains, internal network cryptography, capacity and other queue profiles remain. The Artemis 2.57.0 shared-store backup activated after primary SIGKILL. The same ingress reused the native receipt and queue identity and confirmed the same retry. ActiveMQ Classic 5.19.12 passed shared KahaDB failover. The packaged publisher uses stable OpenWire and Jolokia entries to verify the original ownership and receipt and confirm the exact retry. The restarted former primary stays passive. RocketMQ 5.5.0 broker promotion preserves the native offset and bytes after verifying topic metadata separately on synchronized members. The opt-in Rivomesh publisher resumes the original receipt after a three-replica promotion and refuses publication below two live synchronized replicas. Complete Worker failover, Controller quorum outages and broader security remain.

acceptance.zh-CN: 每个目标验证确认丢失、Broker选主、持久回执、资源丢失、消费者去重/积压以及新跳过缺口协议，明确至少一次及消费完成边界。
acceptance.en: Each queue verifies lost confirmations,election,durable receipts,resource loss,consumer dedup/backlog and skip-gap protocol with honest delivery/consumption boundaries.

title.zh-CN: 可选存储和跨节点数据可达性

gap.zh-CN: 可选日志与 PostgreSQL 同库双证据交接已实测。候选丢失独立日志库链路时控制租约原地续期，原生切点拒绝。复联后可重新核验并暂存，双入口拒绝跨库写入接管。释放后原 Agent 从原断点向两目标续传。异库持久围栏、其他存储和目标拓扑待验。
gap.en: Optional journals and combined PostgreSQL same-database custody passed. During independent journal loss, the candidate keeps its control lease and cannot prove a native cut. After reconnect it can recheck and stage offline history. Both entries refuse cross-database writer transfer. Release lets the original Agent continue to both targets from its original cut. Durable split-store fencing and other storage and destination profiles remain.

acceptance.zh-CN: 无独立存储时明确持久卷/节点绑定与磁盘丢失边界；外部/共享存储按能力验收；跨节点迁移前验证日志、原事件、报告和密钥可达，不可只搬游标；不强制所有部署新增独立日志服务。
acceptance.en: Local mode documents durable volume/pinning/disk-loss limits;external/shared modes are accepted per capability;move verifies logs,evidence,reports and secrets,not just cursors;independent journal infrastructure is not mandatory for every deployment.

title.zh-CN: 真实K8s/CSI与节点故障验收

gap.zh-CN: 双节点 ARM64 实测通过 Helm 和原生 YAML 的镜像升级、RWO CSI 原卷迁移及自动续传。另实测物理 Worker 故障恢复、Secret 轮换、外部日志接管及旧 Worker 写入隔离。
gap.en: Live ARM64 accepted Helm and native YAML image replacement, same-claim RWO CSI relocation and automatic CDC. Separate native cases cover physical worker loss, Secret rotation, external-journal takeover and stale Writer fencing.

acceptance.zh-CN: 在真实集群验证升级、扩缩、Pod/节点故障、RWO/CSI挂载重连、Secret轮换及旧owner隔离，发布实际配置和证据。
acceptance.en: Verify upgrade/scale,pod/node failure,RWO/CSI remount,secret rotation and stale-owner fencing on a real cluster with published configuration/evidence.

verification.profile: Kubernetes v1.31.0 ARM64; Helm and native YAML each six live checks; NFS CSI 4.13.5 on NFS 4.0; prior hostpath physical outage and external PostgreSQL journal stale-worker fixtures

title.zh-CN: 海量对象、大事务和硬件性能标准

gap.zh-CN: Temurin 21 限定资源档案已验收。含 12 轮硬件实测、256 库、超过 8 MiB 的单笔事务、独立日志限额下的慢目标背压和强杀追平。硬件手册记录测量口径及实际资源。
gap.en: The bounded Temurin 21 resource profile is accepted, with 12 hardware trials, 256 mapped databases, a transaction over 8 MiB and slow-target backpressure plus restart recovery through a separate journal.

acceptance.zh-CN: 限制内存/磁盘并处理大事务、海量表和慢目标；记录CPU/内存/磁盘/网络/负载与多轮结果，不线性外推，不以行数一致替代数据一致。
acceptance.en: Bound memory/disk for large transactions/catalogs/slow sinks and publish multi-run hardware/workload results without linear extrapolation or count-only correctness.

verification.profile: Temurin 21 ARM64, 12 content-checked CPU/journal runs, 256 database mappings, 8,505,279-byte binlog transaction and separate-journal slow-target cap with SIGKILL recovery

title.zh-CN: 历史DDL、类型、索引与状态迁移

gap.zh-CN: 对象白名单及 UNIQUE/GSI 转换已有。已实测 MySQL 到 PostgreSQL 的协调冷备和原断点恢复；MySQL 原生 DDL 差异可在两入口按日志与当前目录只读核对。经审阅执行动态 DDL、复杂类型和其他产品待验。 PostgreSQL 17.12 关系变化已实测停留原 LSN。界面审阅包括原生类型声明变化、列顺序和目录已有的索引定义。 JDBC 目标已回归验证身份列换序时仍保护 UNIQUE，显式全局主键和身份 GSI 在建表前要求分布方案。MySQL 源的 Gauss 目标可在管理预检审阅索引动作，覆盖完整统计及有界详情。商用多 CN/DN 和目标目录行为仍需实机验收。 openGauss 7.0.0-RC3 已核对源 UNIQUE(email) 降级与索引 OID 保留，目标主键和同步回执的唯一性保留。
gap.en: Allowlisted objects, UNIQUE/GSI policies and coordinated MySQL-to-PostgreSQL restore have native evidence. Two management entries expose read-only MySQL DDL differences between recorded schema and current catalog. Reviewed DDL execution, more types and other products remain. PostgreSQL 17.12 relation drift retains the original LSN. Read-only catalog review includes native type modifiers, existing column order and collected index definitions. JDBC regressions cover reordered identity UNIQUE and pre-DDL refusal of global primary or identity indexes. Managed Gauss preflight for MySQL reports complete plan counts and bounded details. Native commercial multi-CN/DN and target catalog behavior still need deployment validation. openGauss 7.0.0-RC3 verified UNIQUE(email) downgrade and stable index OIDs while retaining business and receipt primary keys.

acceptance.zh-CN: 对象变化保留源schema历史和审阅计划，身份键不降级；首版状态结构直接创建，不兼容旧开发候选；验证当前状态的备份恢复、损坏拒绝及各产品限制。
acceptance.en: Preserve source schema history,reviewed plans and identity keys;create first-release state directly without prerelease-candidate compatibility;verify current-state backup/restore,corruption refusal and product-specific limits.

title.zh-CN: 报告目录、保留清理与真实浏览器验收

gap.zh-CN: 双入口历史报告/回执、审批、键盘分页、归档和恢复已实测。限定档案回收经停止、保留期、摘要和报告锁检查后只移除已安全归档的重复行文件。
gap.en: Dual-entry report/receipt discovery, approvals, keyboard pagination, archival and exact restore passed. The bounded reclaim profile removes only an archived duplicate row file after stop, retention, digest and active-lock checks.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提供授权报告/凭据检索、保留与活动文件保护；真实浏览器验证跨节点、刷新登录、计划确认、错误恢复和大表分页，补齐可访问性检查。
acceptance.en: Provide authorized report/receipt search,retention and active-file protection;real browsers verify cluster/session/confirmation/recovery/pagination and accessibility.

verification.profile: Temurin 21, PostgreSQL shared control, MySQL 8.4.13, 18 native checks with eight real Chrome, 47 Java, 136 DOM, plus earlier history and paging archive

title.zh-CN: 外部身份、不可变审计与Apache准备
title.en: External identity,immutable audit and Apache preparation

gap.zh-CN: 本地 MinIO 已验收签名检查点、完整审计事件、Object Lock COMPLIANCE、精确版本及跨批次恢复。已核对五路外置 JDBC、SBOM 和发行包嵌套依赖。Keycloak 26.7.4、真实 Chrome、共享 PostgreSQL 控制库及双 Controller HTTPS 入口通过登录、本地账号权限和撤销。真实 AWS、生产入口、提供方主动撤销、项目授权和最终 LICENSE/NOTICE 待完成。
gap.en: Native MinIO covers signed checkpoints, complete audit events, Object Lock COMPLIANCE, exact versions and continuity. Five external JDBC drivers, the SBOM and nested package review have evidence. Real Keycloak 26.7.4 and Chrome passed OIDC login, local account grants and revocation over two Controller HTTPS routes with shared PostgreSQL. Real AWS, production ingress, provider-initiated revocation, source rights and final LICENSE/NOTICE remain.

acceptance.zh-CN: 核验外部身份映射/撤销、外部审计留存和依赖分发条件，补齐许可证NOTICE/SBOM/贡献文档；Rivomesh不自称已获Apache身份或商标权。
acceptance.en: Verify external identity/revocation,external audit and distribution conditions;complete license/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution docs without claiming Apache affiliation or trademark rights.

candidateVerification.scope: Bounded RC03;initial full reactor has one30s fixture lease expiry during678s setup;focused51 retry and final JAR-first51 pass with unchanged production fences/fixture lease. Native34 per product and CDC26 per control store pass. Not a single clean full-reactor run;no full JDK/vendor/TLS/liveK8s claim.
